text: {"score":3,"justification":"Numbers match the card and the tone is cautious, but the headline overstates what the data show and the cited examples and next steps are weak. The core numbers (26.9% vs 3.8%, 5.64, 4.13, 24%, 2 of 22, 5 documented 99215s all supported) are accurate. The rationale is thorough and flags thin documentation. It also usefully notes the C0028859 Z09 visit with high MDM. However, the headline says 'well above expectation in every complexity tier', which is loosely supported by the tier table but not tied to expected shares per tier. The 'cited_claim_ids' and the code-written examples list C0028805 (a below-billed 99213, irrelevant to the upcoding concern) and two low-complexity 99215s, while the more telling ones from the narrative (C0028825, C0028834, C0028935, C0028859, C0028853, C0028868) are not in the cited list. The next steps are generic and do not name specific claims, although the rationale does. The leaning 'inconclusive' sits awkwardly with the 'leans toward concern' wording.","problems":["Headline claim 'in every complexity tier' is overstated; 1-condition tier is 10.9% vs 3.0% but the framing mixes provider and all-provider shares without per-tier comparison.","cited_claim_ids omit most claims named in the narrative (C0028825, C0028834, C0028935, C0028853, C0028868, C0028859), so citations are weakly aligned with the points.","Example C0028805 (99213 billed below documented level... actually documented straightforward) is irrelevant to the 99215 upcoding concern and wastes an example slot.","Next steps are generic ('larger sample', 're-screen') and don't name the specific low-complexity 99215 claims that the rationale recommends requesting.","Mixed signal: 'leans toward concern' in text versus 'inconclusive' leaning; the Z09 documented-high-MDM claim is noted but not carried into the steps.","'Z09 follow-up', 'R21 rash' descriptions are interpretive labels; also C0028783 and C0028810 example diagnoses (E03.9;N39.0) aren't discussed."]}
